name: io.github.carrotly-ai/disclosures
description: Corporate disclosures from 26 official sources across 21 jurisdiction routes via ten tools.

environmentVariables.name: DISCLOSURES_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Descriptive User-Agent with contact info, required only for SEC-backed US operations (e.g. 'Your Org you@example.com'). SEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT is also accepted.

environmentVariables.name: COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UK Companies House API key. Required only for GB operations.

environmentVariables.name: OPENDART_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: South Korea OpenDART API key. Required only for KR operations.

environmentVariables.name: EDINET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Japan EDINET API key. Required only for JP document search; JP resolution is keyless.

environmentVariables.name: DBD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Thailand DBD API key. Required only for company-name search; exact 13-digit juristic-person lookups are keyless.

environmentVariables.name: DISCLOSURES_ACKNOWLEDGE_ASX_TERMS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 only after reviewing ASX's restrictive terms and confirming you have the rights to use ASX data. ASIC open-data routes remain available without it.

environmentVariables.name: DISCLOSURES_ACKNOWLEDGE_PSE_TERMS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 only after reviewing PSE EDGE's restrictive terms and confirming you have the rights to use PSE data.
